name: Needle and Thread
summary: Big sewing needle with a loop of thread through the eye, optional wooden spool; for sewing, tailoring and craft scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the needle lies on y

params.name: s
params.note: hero scale: about 340 px long at s = 1 (about 420 px with the spool); use about 0.25–0.35 next to a person

params.name: spool
params.note: true = add a wooden spool wound with the thread

params.name: anim
params.note: wiggle = the loose thread swings round the eye

author: krakujs
